title: Morning traffic news
instructions: Sabah radyosunda trafik haberleri. Yolları, sebepleri ve önerileri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Good morning. It's seven forty-five, and here is the traffic news.

script.speaker: host
script.text: There's an accident on the A6 near the airport. Traffic is very slow, so please use the A8.

script.speaker: host
script.text: In the city centre, Park Road is closed all day because of building work.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The trains are running normally this morning, but buses on route twelve are about twenty minutes late.

script.speaker: host
script.text: If you're driving to the football match tonight, the car park at the stadium is full. Take the free bus from the station.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The next traffic news is at eight fifteen.

options: on the A8 near the station
on the A6 near the airport
questions.evidence: There's an accident on the A6 near the airport.

questions.feedback: Park Road inşaat çalışması (building work) yüzünden kapalı.
questions.evidence: Park Road is closed all day because of building work.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the buses on route twelve?
options: They are about twenty minutes late.
questions.feedback: On iki numaralı hat otobüsleri yaklaşık yirmi dakika gecikmeli. Trenler normal.
questions.evidence: buses on route twelve are about twenty minutes late.

questions.prompt: How should football fans get to the stadium?
options: by the free bus from the station
questions.feedback: Stadyum otoparkı dolu; istasyondan kalkan ücretsiz otobüse binmeliler.
questions.evidence: Take the free bus from the station.

questions.prompt: When is the next traffic news?
questions.feedback: Sonraki trafik haberleri sekizi çeyrek geçe (eight fifteen). 7:45 şu anki saat.
questions.evidence: The next traffic news is at eight fifteen.
